title: Cover evaluator evidence reads after the reader changes on the same store
outcome: A changed Work reader configuration on the same store withdraws admission for previously captured acceptance evidence. Add behavioral coverage for a changed developer name or binary path while retaining the established store.
acceptance: With the store unchanged and a cached selected or catalog reply present, changing the reader configuration makes replay return a conflict and withhold the previous body.
A fresh read on the same moved reader records an unfinished reason without issuing any tracker read.
